note: Outline of the 10-part order from the KillerKitten walkthrough. Segment costs are only listed where a source states them; everything else is shown as unknown.

parts.title: Prologue
parts.focus: About 24 segments. Save your mother before sunset and finish 'Smoke and Ashes'.

steps.text: Take Anca's medicine and answer 'I really have to go' (1 segment instead of 2).
With Pieter agree to be home before dusk (1 segment instead of 3).
Active side quests fail when sundown arrives, so do the quick ones before it.

parts.title: Part 1 - Ambrus
parts.focus: Laslea Glen and Briar Sloughs. Ruin Ambrus's activities and prepare the duel.

parts.title: Part 2 - Crake
parts.focus: Svartrau Outskirts. Start Crake's line and the Sanzhani chain.

steps.text: Finish the Sanzhani chain: it returns a full day.
steps.note: Good Home unlocks the other four quests.

parts.title: Part 3 - Bakir
parts.focus: Svartrau City. Ruin Bakir's activities and reach the Lunar Game.

parts.title: Part 6 - Anca and St. Mihai
parts.focus: Anca's chain (22 segments) and the St. Mihai sword.

steps.text: Shortcut: at night drop into the cathedral from the roof.

parts.title: Part 10 - Crake
parts.focus: Close Crake's line and the story.

steps.text: Manual save before the final quest ('A Deal with the Devil').

budget.name: Prologue
budget.note: Counted as spent from the start.

budget.name: Sanzhani chain (Good Home + 4 quests)
budget.note: Gives back an extra full day. Trophy: The Tsarina's Favourite Human.

budget.name: Anca: Font of Life (4 quests)
budget.note: 8 + 4 + 4 + 6. 1800 XP, 4 skill points. Trophy: Sins of the Past.

budget.name: Lacra (6 quests)
budget.note: 3 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 7, then Midnight Reckoning. Trophies: Misery Loves Company, The Patricide.

budget.name: Crake (10 quests)
budget.note: 4, ?, 5, 8, 6, 7, 3, 1, 3, 3 (Shadows in the Woods is not listed). Trophies: The Manumit, The Knyazmaker.

budget.name: Tear down 5 banners in Svartrau City
budget.note: 1 segment each, 100 XP each. Trophy: Capture the Flag.

budget.name: Max all of Swordmastery
budget.note: Rough figure from the Steam tips guide.

budget.name: Home Sweet Home (Silts tower)
budget.note: To enter. Needed for Together Forever and the Arbiter's armour.
